comment: No family is set on the jacks: the matrix carries whatever is patched into it, audio or CV alike. The switch at row r and column c is parameter r + c * 10 (src/MentalPatchMatrix.cpp:166), and all hundred do the same thing, so they share one line. The outputs are the plain sum of the inputs switched into them with no attenuation anywhere in the module.
